name: blackbox
description: 0G decides. Blackbox proves it. Verifiable decision recorder for inspection robots on 0G.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix core install && python3 -m venv robot/.venv && robot/.venv/bin/pip install -r robot/requirements.txt && forge install --root contracts --no-git --shallow foundry-rs/forge-std
scripts.test: npm run test:contracts && npm run test:robot && npm run test:core
scripts.test:core: npm --prefix core run typecheck && npm --prefix core test
